description:
Reviews a schematic (in the standard schema) against deterministic embedded-board rules: decoupling, reset, I2C pull-ups, power, interface wiring and MCU-family requirements.

For a schematic image or PDF, call embedcalc_get_extraction_guide first and follow its page-by-page procedure (embedcalc_check_transcription after each page); pass the netlist here only once that check returns ready=true.
For a KiCad netlist or a PADS PCB file (+ BOM), pass the output of embedcalc_parse_kicad / embedcalc_parse_pads with mcu.family added — preferred over images.

Returns { violations[], checked[], skipped[], interfacesDetected[] }. "skipped" lists rules that could not run on the given data — read it to know the coverage; a clean result only covers the rules in "checked". interfacesDetected lists the interface packs (usb/can/rs485/swd/crystal) recognised from net names.

Known limits — tell the user when they apply: a rail with no capacitor is reported twice (decoupling error + bulk warning); a ferrite bead whose value is only a part number is not recognised, so each side is reported as its own rail; decoupling/bulk run only on rails that feed an ic/mcu pin; on-board debugger detection relies on ICE-prefixed references (Nuvoton Nu-Link). A violation means the netlist matches the rule, not that the board is wrong — evaluation boards often leave ESD or I2C pull-ups to the attached board on purpose.
name: embedcalc_review_schematic
title: Review Schematic
